snippet.title: Sonic Legacy Demo: Unleashed Update
snippet.description:
Sonic Legacy is a 3D Sonic fangame made in the Bumper Engine. This new update adds Apotos and Dragon Road to the game. Wave Ocean also has improved Water effects, sonic has improved physics and a few other changes.
